label: preparing
what: Likely a surprise celebration of my forty years as mayor in the great hall at eighteen, presented to me as a lighting/readiness inspection. Secretary arranged the appointment, builder and innkeeper prepared the hall and lanterns, and freight is now escorting me there. Neighbour appears to help keep my tea schedule and confirm my attendance; baker's lantern/material exchanges suggest assistance. The celebration itself has not been explicitly disclosed, so this remains an inference.
